stock.description: Zhonggan Communication (Group) Holdings Limited, established in Nanchang, China in 2002, operates as a key provider of telecommunications infrastructure and digital transformation solutions within China. The company specializes in constructing and enhancing network infrastructure, encompassing everything from base station deployment, telecommunications equipment configuration, and cable installation to power generation facilities and foundational works. Beyond construction, Zhonggan ensures network reliability through comprehensive infrastructure maintenance, including routine servicing, repair work, and rapid emergency response to system failures. Furthermore, the company delivers advanced infrastructure digitalization solutions. These encompass integrated services covering system design, strategic planning, provision of both hardware and software, and seamless installation and integration, complemented by robust after-sales support. Their offerings also extend to system maintenance for digital platforms, providing technical assistance and ongoing upkeep for both hardware and software components. Additionally, Zhonggan develops and offers proprietary software solutions, alongside bespoke software development services. These digitalization capabilities serve a wide array of sectors, such as digital healthcare, education, surveillance, government, industrial management, and urban administration. Zhonggan's diverse clientele includes telecommunications network operators, various levels of government, quasi-governmental entities, state-owned enterprises, and private sector companies. The company is a subsidiary of GT & Yangtze Limited.
